title: New Reasoning Models Now Available
excerpt: Try the newest reasoning models for complex math, code and analysis tasks.

content.p: Reasoning models spend more compute before answering, which pays off on hard math, multi-step logic and tricky debugging tasks.
They are already available on your account. Just select a reasoning model in your token settings and go.

faq.q: Are reasoning models available on all plans?
faq.a: Yes. Any account with credits can call reasoning models.
Select a reasoning model in your token settings — no extra configuration needed.
They use more compute on hard tasks, so their per-token price is higher than mini models.

faq.q: Can I stream with reasoning models?
faq.a: Yes, streaming works exactly the same as with any other model.
